"We are using Agentic #AI  in our phone system to do amazing stuff such as:

Letting callers know what our business hours and address are!

Basic voice recognition to route callers to a queue until a live person is available!

Suggest basic troubleshooting tips that are not at all helpful!

Inform them of an outage!"

...weren't companies already doing that before all this #agenticai bullshit?
